claim: A modified file could be declared deleted, removing its hash and worktree comparison while still existing at source and in the worktree.
evidence: An isolated probe set deleted_files=[source.txt] and file_hashes={} for a modified source file; check-records returned no errors.
impact: The accepted source could differ from reviewed source.
required_action: Require every deleted file to be absent at source_revision and in the working tree.

prevention.action: Validate deleted_files with git cat-file and a worktree absence check.
